one_liner: Time tracking, expense reporting, and invoicing software with a comprehensive REST API.
auth_notes: Supports OAuth2 (Authorization Code or Implicit Grant) and Personal Access Tokens (Bearer token).
access_notes: Requires a Harvest account, which offers a time-limited free trial before requiring a paid plan.
api_notes: Covers clients, company settings, invoices, estimates, expenses, tasks, timesheets, projects, roles, users, reports, and PTO.
blocker_notes: Harvest requires a paid subscription after the initial trial period to maintain API access.

auth.quote: The V2 API requires an access token to authenticate requests. There are two options available to you: A Personal Access Token which is tied directly to you and is the quickest way to start playing around with the API. Implementing a full OAuth2 Authentication flow which allows other people to use your Harvest integrations.

api.quote: Harvest requires applications to authenticate all requests with OAuth2 or Personal Access Tokens
